contract: VocalisMeta refresh, provenance and migration contract

transport.canonical_payload_encoding: ASCII JSON; ASCII schema object keys sorted lexicographically; NFC text values; ensure_ascii=true; no whitespace; no floats; unescaped slash; standard JSON short control escapes
transport.compression: zlib (RFC1950); digest is over uncompressed canonical JSON, never compressed bytes
transport.binary_encoding: unpadded base64url of the complete compressed payload, then split into chunks
transport.failure_behavior: Treat v4 as unavailable; retain last valid client projection. Still reserve every prefix from author parsing.
transport.recording_binding: Reference decode_for_recording binds the decoded recording_key to independently parsed v1 GUID/canonical key; mismatch is invalid.

fields.title: Plex album title; nullable text
fields.authors: Exact author/co-author Mood names, sorted NFC set; primary Plex artist remains a separate native field
fields.narrators: Exact Style names, sorted NFC set
fields.recording_date: Published Plex originallyAvailableAt, YYYY-MM-DD; provenance.date_kind distinguishes recording and literary-date fallbacks
fields.language: Published Language display label or null
fields.work: Validated v2 openlibrary:<OL…W> or null; grouping only
fields.work_publication: Validated v3 year string or null
fields.contributors: Validated original v3 Contributor-ID tag strings; name source remains non-authoritative
fields.artwork: sha256:<accepted-input-bytes> or null; identical to revisions.artwork

states.known: Use value; stale=true means retained previous evidence
states.unknown: Unknown/unsupported; do not infer a clear or a negative fact
states.unavailable: Temporary lookup problem; keep retained value/client cache and retry later
states.cleared: Deliberate tombstone; remove only the corresponding agent-owned projection

revisions.metadata: sha256:<canonical semantic published projection>; meaningful values, explicit primary/exact memberships, deliberate clears, and legacy published fields
revisions.artwork: sha256:<accepted primary image input bytes>; exclude URLs, poster keys, transcodes and timestamps
revisions.ordering: Set-valued strings sorted by canonical escaped JSON bytes after NFC/deduplication. Primary series explicit, secondaries sorted by relationship ref.
revisions.rating: Existing numeric rating is quantized to six decimal places and serialized as trimmed decimal text in the metadata projection.
revisions.client_behavior: Use each revision for its own cache. Always inspect state/provenance on a new detail response even when revisions are unchanged.

series_rules.reference: relationship:SHA256(canonical {title,sequence,provider_id?}); an envelope-local relationship ref, NOT an authoritative series ID

ljudboksarkivet.id: Safe same-provider /bokserie/<slug> link actually supplied by the page

series_rules.no_id: Keep exact NFC display title/sequence; never invent an authoritative identifier from the name
series_rules.primary: Fresh provider order or explicit embedded/manual series selection; preserve prior v4 primary on partial response. Never infer from returned Mood order.
series_rules.total: Not published; indexed library coverage is not a publisher-defined total

verified_conditions: new key is an exact-confirmed Audible or LibriVox recording
same explicit ASIN and region present in both stored recording profiles OR same explicit LibriVox project in both
no known language, abridgment, narrator, runtime or explicit recording-ID conflicts
identity_upgrades.runtime_tolerance: max(60000 milliseconds, 0.5% of the shorter known runtime)
identity_upgrades.strong_conflict_behavior: Review required, including different Audible regions/editions. No automatic equivalence.
identity_upgrades.application_behavior: Preview and ask the user before copying/merging state. Agent never reads/writes listening databases.

rollout: All readers first reserve the prefix, even if not parsing v4
Implement and test the parser/cache/migration safeguards in compatible clients
User enables v4 on a test library only after every reader is compatible
Refresh albums; missing v4 never means v1-v3 data or listening state was cleared
